description: This file defines the SuiteLogger class, a PSR-3 compliant logger that extends AbstractLogger and provides logging functionality with support for various log levels. It utilizes a LoggerManager to obtain the logger instance and formats messages with context-aware interpolation.

classes.name: SuiteLogger
classes.description: A PSR-3 compliant logger class that logs messages at different severity levels by interacting with an external LoggerManager.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified level with optional context data, formatting the message accordingly.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the message with corresponding context values, supporting string conversion.
